Masahiko Tanaka (Japanese: 田中正彦 Tanaka Masahiko) is a Japanese voice actor for .

==Biography==
Tanaka was born on October 1, 1954, in , . As an adult, he became a voice actor for several anime series. He has occasionally provided his voice for since the original series, and his best-known role was as the .
